raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
### What does this PR do?

Multi-node vLLM rollout replicas (`data_parallel_size > data_parallel_size_local`) fail at engine start on vLLM ≥ 0.28 with

```
Remote engine 15 must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb mode
```

`vLLMHttpServer` starts node 0 as the API server and nodes > 0 with `run_headless`, but passes `data_parallel_start_rank = node_rank * data_parallel_size_local` to **every** node. Since vLLM 0.28, `EngineArgs.create_engine_config` infers hybrid-LB mode when `data_parallel_start_rank is not None and not headless` (still the case on vLLM `main`, `vllm/engine/arg_utils.py`), and in hybrid-LB mode the leader rejects headless remote engines. The node-0 server is the internal-LB leader and must not carry a start rank; its local engines start at rank 0 anyway.

This PR only sets `data_parallel_start_rank` for `node_rank > 0`. #6856 covered the pre-0.28 semantics and was closed by a vLLM-side port fix (vllm-project/vllm#49212); this is the 0.28+ follow-up. gpustack, kserve and vllm-ascend made the same change in Sep–Oct 2026.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs. Paste at least one query link here: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+data_parallel_start_rank ; https://github.com/verl-project/verl/issues?q=headless+hybrid
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`

### Test

Cannot be covered by CI (needs a replica spanning several nodes). Validated on a GB200 cluster (4 GPUs per node, aarch64), verl `1d367a4f` + vLLM 0.29.0, DeepSeek-V4-Pro with `moe_backend=marlin`:

- without the change: 16 replicas × 16 GPUs (4 nodes each) all fail with the message above within 8 minutes of job start;
- with the change: 8 replicas × 32 GPUs (8 nodes each) load, allocate KV cache, capture CUDA graphs and serve; GRPO runs end to end (rollout/actor log-prob Pearson 0.995), 15+ multi-node runs since, including 128-node runs (16 replicas × 32 GPUs).

Single-node replicas (`data_parallel_size_local == data_parallel_size`) are unaffected: vLLM disables hybrid-LB for that case regardless of the start rank; an 8-node smoke with one replica per node behaves identically before and after.

### API and Usage Example

No API change.

### Design & Code Changes

`verl/workers/rollout/vllm_rollout/vllm_async_server.py`: move the `data_parallel_start_rank` entry of `dp_args` under `if self.node_rank > 0`, with a comment explaining the vLLM semantics.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Apply pre-commit checks: not run on my side (no x86 dev environment; the change is 9 lines, within the 120-column limit). Happy to fix anything the CI linter reports.
- [ ] Documentation: not needed (bug fix, no user-facing change).
- [ ] Tests: not feasible in CI — requires a multi-node replica; validation above.
- [ ] CI request: will post in `ci-request` once a maintainer confirms the approach.

Validated on H100 (80 GB, 8 GPUs/node, vLLM 0.29.0, verl `main@45a40312` with this exact change applied as a local patch), in two multi-node DP shapes:

- **DeepSeek-V4-Flash**, rollout `tensor_model_parallel_size=8, data_parallel_size=2, expert_parallel_size=16` (one replica spans 2 nodes): 4 replicas on 8 nodes all pass the engine handshake; 3 GRPO steps complete, rollout/actor log-prob Pearson 0.994.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Pro** (1.57 T), rollout `TP8 × DP8 × EP64` (one replica spans 8 nodes): 8 replicas on 64 nodes come up in ≈13 min; 5 GRPO steps complete, Pearson 0.994–0.995.

Without the patch the same 64-node job fails exactly as described: node 0 logs `data_parallel_hybrid_lb is not eligible when data_parallel_size_local = 1, autoswitch to data_parallel_external_lb`, then `RuntimeError: Remote engine 1 must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb mode`. With `TP8` on 8-GPU nodes `data_parallel_size_local` is 1, so the hybrid-LB inference on the leader is the only trigger — removing the leader's `start_rank` is sufficient, no other change was needed.

One more data point on why this matters: I am preparing an `examples/grpo_trainer/run_deepseek_v4_pro_megatron.sh` for DeepSeek-V4-**Pro** (61 layers; a vLLM replica spans 8 nodes, TP8 × DP8 on H100 and DP32 on GB200), and the cross-node data-parallel rollout cannot start on `main` without this change — vLLM 0.29 still rejects the headless engines on the non-leader nodes (`Remote engine N must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb mode`). Re-verified today on `main@a4b9354` + this patch with the 4-layer Pro smoke on GB200 (4-layer, 8 nodes, 2 steps, Pearson 0.9992–0.9994) and with the 61-layer model on 64 nodes (3 steps, Pearson 0.998, rollout TP1 × DP32 × EP32). The example is now up as #8383 and names this PR as a prerequisite until it lands; happy to rebase either side if you want any change here first.

files.patch:
@@ -396,10 +396,22 @@ async def launch_server(self, master_address: str = None, master_port: int = Non
             dp_args = {
                 "data_parallel_size": self.config.data_parallel_size,
                 "data_parallel_size_local": data_parallel_size_local,
-                "data_parallel_start_rank": self.node_rank * data_parallel_size_local,
                 "data_parallel_address": self._master_address,
                 "data_parallel_rpc_port": self._dp_rpc_port,
             }
+            if self.node_rank > 0:
+                # Only the headless follower nodes get a start rank. Since vLLM 0.28 a
+                # non-headless server that receives ``data_parallel_start_rank`` is put
+                # into hybrid-LB mode (EngineArgs.create_engine_config), and in that
+                # mode the leader rejects headless remote engines with
+                # "Remote engine N must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb
+                # mode". The node-0 API server is the internal-LB leader and must not
+                # carry a start rank (its local engines start at rank 0 anyway).
+                dp_args["data_parallel_start_rank"] = self.node_rank * data_parallel_size_local
+            else:
+                # A start rank configured through engine_kwargs would put the leader into
+                # hybrid-LB mode just the same; the leader's engines always start at rank 0.
+                args.pop("data_parallel_start_rank", None)
             args.update(dp_args)
 
         args.update({"enable_expert_parallel": self.config.expert_parallel_size > 1})

Validated on H100 (80 GB, 8 GPUs/node, vLLM 0.29.0, verl `main@45a40312` with this exact change applied as a local patch), in two multi-node DP shapes:

- **DeepSeek-V4-Flash**, rollout `tensor_model_parallel_size=8, data_parallel_size=2, expert_parallel_size=16` (one replica spans 2 nodes): 4 replicas on 8 nodes all pass the engine handshake; 3 GRPO steps complete, rollout/actor log-prob Pearson 0.994.
- **DeepSeek-V4-Pro** (1.57 T), rollout `TP8 × DP8 × EP64` (one replica spans 8 nodes): 8 replicas on 64 nodes come up in ≈13 min; 5 GRPO steps complete, Pearson 0.994–0.995.

Without the patch the same 64-node job fails exactly as described: node 0 logs `data_parallel_hybrid_lb is not eligible when data_parallel_size_local = 1, autoswitch to data_parallel_external_lb`, then `RuntimeError: Remote engine 1 must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb mode`. With `TP8` on 8-GPU nodes `data_parallel_size_local` is 1, so the hybrid-LB inference on the leader is the only trigger — removing the leader's `start_rank` is sufficient, no other change was needed.

One more data point on why this matters: I am preparing an `examples/grpo_trainer/run_deepseek_v4_pro_megatron.sh` for DeepSeek-V4-**Pro** (61 layers; a vLLM replica spans 8 nodes, TP8 × DP8 on H100 and DP32 on GB200), and the cross-node data-parallel rollout cannot start on `main` without this change — vLLM 0.29 still rejects the headless engines on the non-leader nodes (`Remote engine N must not use --headless in external or hybrid dp lb mode`).
